Arrival history and monthly calendar

See when and how an arrival was recorded.

Browse the Mac arrival calendar and date details, or the Windows recent-record list.

Monthly calendar: Mac 1.5.16 build32 · Recent list: Windows 1.5.13
OverviewHow to useExampleScope and limitsRelated features

Understand each saved arrival

On Mac, choose a date in the monthly arrival calendar. Details distinguish arrival time, workday mode and the source: login detected, unlock detected or manual entry.

Windows 1.5.13 shows date, arrival, mode and source in Settings → Recent history. It does not include Mac’s month navigation and calendar date-detail interface.

Browse your records

  1. On Mac, open Attendance in settings.
  2. Move to the previous or next month and select a date. Today returns to the current month and date.
  3. Read the arrival, workday mode, source and recorded time zone in date details.
  4. On Windows, right-click the tray icon and open Settings → Recent history.

Mac’s Open record folder action locates the stored file. Viewing records does not require editing or deleting that file.

An unlock or a manual entry

If an arrival was detected automatically and you later correct its time, date details show the saved time with a manual-entry source. This is an illustrative example, not an actual user record.

On Mac, choosing leave marks the date and explains that an earlier arrival is retained. A date without a saved arrival shows no record, separately from a day when automatic recording was paused.

Storage and preservation

Mac stores arrivals at ~/Library/Application Support/AfterSix/state.json; Windows uses %LOCALAPPDATA%\HappyLulu\state.json. Records belong to each computer and do not sync between them.

If the file cannot be read, the app preserves it and stops new saves. Do not delete the original to update or troubleshoot. Mac displays arrivals in their recorded time zone.

An empty date is not evidence of absence. The app does not reconstruct unobserved historical arrivals or certify actual departure and total hours worked. This arrival calendar is separate from external event calendars.
